_comment: Code of the game's executable that is not lifted (ps3recomp ppu_lifter.py --traps; docs/OPENAL_MIGRATION_PLAN.md
section 9): each function starting in a range is lifted as a call of ppu_trap -- reaching it reports the address
and ends the game -- and the runtime treats any other address in a range the same way. The ranges follow the
lift's function boundaries (the lifter refuses one that cuts a function). Addresses only: no code.
FMOD Ex (M5, 2026-11-12): its PPU library and the out-of-line methods of its classes (the virtual functions its
vtables hold, placed apart from the library). The game's audio is the native sound manager on OpenAL Soft;
the sound manager's methods are answered natively, so nothing calls FMOD's API. The 28 call stubs the sound
manager's class used to call FMOD's API (0x00987478-0x00987658, TOC-switching glue, no FMOD code) stay lifted:
a call through one lands in a trap.

Bink (M8.4, 2026-11-13; docs/FFMPEG_MIGRATION_PLAN.md sections 2.2 and 6.4): its PPU library, closed as tools/movie_inventory.py checks it -- nothing outside it but its eleven call stubs (0x009873A8-0x00987458, TOC-switching glue, no Bink code; they stay lifted) reaches it, its pointer-reached functions held only by its own tables, no constructor. The game's movie class's calls through those stubs are answered natively (config/m8_native_movie.json: FFmpeg).
spu_images: FMOD's SPU programs (the mixer, its NeuralTHX variant, its 19 relocatable plugins), not lifted.

inert: FMOD's static constructors (39, in the C runtime's constructor table, 0x00FE0000-0x00FE0718) and destructors (2, its destructor table after it), which the start-up and the exit call for every file: lifted as a plain return -- they set up and tear down only FMOD's own globals.

traps.note: FMOD Ex's PPU library: 2,792 functions in the function list
FMOD's classes' out-of-line methods: 60 functions, each held only by FMOD's vtables
Bink's PPU library: 151 functions and 49 alignment pads in the function list, reached only through its eleven call stubs
